title: Can You Rob Houses in GTA 6? Yes, But Some Aren't Empty 🏠 #Shorts
description:
Yes, you can rob houses in GTA 6, with no requirements, from Chapter 1. Dark blue buildings on the Vice City map can be robbed (light blue can't). Break the door open (loud) or use the Snap Gun (quiet, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission "Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs"). Inside: cash, drugs, guns, ammo and collectible trading cards that only appear in NPC homes, plus safes. Risks: some homes have alarms that alert the cops, getting caught gives you a Wanted Level, and some NPCs inside carry guns.

Source: GTABase, "How to Break Into Houses in GTA 6 for Home Robberies" (Nov 26, 2026).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look, Launch Trailer, official character clip).
